title: Place the subject with intent
summary: Composition is an intentional arrangement of attention. Subject placement, contrast, scale, and surrounding space can each change what the viewer notices first.
objectives: Explain visual emphasis and its limits.

options.text: Composition is an intentional arrangement of attention. Subject placement, contrast, scale, and surrounding space can each change what the viewer notices first.

options.text: One setting or rule guarantees a good photograph.
options.rationale: The effect depends on the intention and conditions; no universal quality guarantee follows.

questions.prompt: What should you do after making the proposed change?

options.text: Compare the result with your intention and identify what actually changed.
options.rationale: This names the relevant effect and invites checking its limits.

options.text: Treat a brighter or grid-aligned result as automatic success.
options.rationale: Brightness and grid alignment alone do not establish the intended outcome.
